script:
# D3-SO-003: Tertiary substrate plus strong base is not automatically an SN2 example
# Simulation candidate; no runtime observations are claimed.
new
add v1 water 40mL @ 25C
add v1 NaOH 0.0003mol
add v2 water 40mL @ 25C
add v2 NaOH 0.0003mol
seal v1 500mL
seal v2 500mL
add v1 bromoethane 0.0002mol
add v2 tert_butyl_bromide 0.0002mol
react v1 haloalkane
react v2 haloalkane
particles v1
particles v2
measure v1 pressure
measure v2 pressure
inspect
